name: Signal Cache Scout Bench
blurb: Workshop tool, not a game region: readability range for the signal-cache pickup (weathered tripod + floating lore-violet octahedron) over a distance ladder, against day/dusk/night backdrops and storm dust, alongside live replicas of the shipping HUD hint chip and minimap diamond, with CVD simulation and contrast tables for tuning emissive/glint thresholds. Anchors and center live outside the playable map.
